description: Initialize Next.js project with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS
steps: Run npx create-next-app@latest with TypeScript and Tailwind
Verify dev server starts with npm run dev
Verify TypeScript compiles with npm run build

description: Set up project structure with services, components, hooks, and types directories
steps: Create /src/services directory for API clients
Create /src/components directory for React components
Create /src/hooks directory for custom hooks
Create /src/types directory for TypeScript types
Verify structure matches planned architecture

description: Define core TypeScript types for weather data model
steps: Create /src/types/weather.ts with WeatherData interface
Include fields: temperature, feelsLike, precipitation, humidity, windSpeed, windDirection, visibility, uvIndex, weatherCode
Create TimelinePoint type with timestamp and weather data
Verify types compile without errors

description: Implement Open-Meteo API client for forecast data
steps: Create /src/services/openMeteo.ts
Implement fetchForecast(lat, lon) function
Return hourly data with past 8 hours and next 48 hours
Include minutely_15 precipitation data for next 2 hours
Verify API returns valid data for a US location (e.g., NYC: 40.7128, -74.0060)

description: Implement NWS API client for alerts and backup data
steps: Create /src/services/nwsApi.ts
Implement fetchAlerts(lat, lon) function
Implement fetchHourlyForecast(lat, lon) function
Handle NWS two-step API (points -> gridpoint forecast)
Verify alerts endpoint returns data for a US location

description: Create unified weather API aggregation layer
steps: Create /src/services/weatherApi.ts
Implement getWeatherTimeline(lat, lon) that combines Open-Meteo and NWS data
Return unified TimelinePoint[] array spanning past 8h to future 48h
Include 5-minute granularity for next 2 hours using minutely data
Implement fallback: if Open-Meteo fails, use NWS data

description: Implement geolocation hook for user location
steps: Create /src/hooks/useLocation.ts
Request browser geolocation permission
Return { latitude, longitude, error, loading } state
Handle permission denied gracefully with error message
Verify hook works on mobile browser

description: Implement weather data fetching hook
steps: Create /src/hooks/useWeatherData.ts
Accept latitude and longitude parameters
Fetch weather timeline using weatherApi service
Return { timeline, currentWeather, loading, error } state
Implement refetch function for manual refresh

description: Build timeline slider component with past/future visualization
steps: Create /src/components/TimelineSlider.tsx
Display horizontal slider spanning past 8h to future 48h
Mark current time distinctly on the slider
Show 5-minute tick marks for next 2 hours
Show hourly tick marks beyond 2 hours
Implement drag/touch interaction to scrub through time
Verify slider is touch-friendly on mobile (44px+ touch targets)

description: Build weather card component showing current conditions
steps: Create /src/components/WeatherCard.tsx
Display temperature (actual and feels like)
Display precipitation probability and type
Display wind speed and direction
Display humidity, visibility, UV index
Show weather condition icon
Update display when slider position changes

description: Build location picker component for manual location entry
steps: Create /src/components/LocationPicker.tsx
Allow ZIP code or city name input
Geocode input to lat/lon coordinates
Display current location name
Allow switching between GPS and manual location

description: Implement hyper-local weather suggestions engine
steps: Create /src/utils/weatherSuggestions.ts
Analyze next 2 hours of weather data
Generate contextual suggestions (e.g., 'Rain in 45 min - bring umbrella')
Include temperature change warnings
Include precipitation timing alerts
Include clear weather window suggestions

description: Build suggestion banner component
steps: Create /src/components/SuggestionBanner.tsx
Display top weather suggestion prominently
Allow dismissing/cycling through multiple suggestions
Style with appropriate weather-related colors/icons

description: Assemble main page with all components
steps: Update /src/app/page.tsx as main entry point
Integrate LocationPicker at top
Integrate SuggestionBanner below location
Integrate WeatherCard as main display
Integrate TimelineSlider at bottom
Wire up state so slider controls WeatherCard display

description: Implement mobile-first responsive design
steps: Ensure all components work at 320px width minimum
Test on iOS Safari and Android Chrome
Verify touch interactions work smoothly
Implement bottom sheet pattern for detailed info on mobile
Test at tablet (768px) and desktop (1024px+) breakpoints

description: Add dark/light mode support
steps: Detect system color scheme preference
Implement theme toggle in UI
Ensure all components respect theme
Verify contrast ratios meet accessibility standards

description: Create historical accuracy validation script
steps: Create /scripts/validateAccuracy.ts
Define list of 200+ US cities with coordinates
Fetch historical forecast vs actual data from Open-Meteo
Calculate temperature MAE (target: < 3°F)
Calculate precipitation timing accuracy (target: within 10 min)
Generate accuracy report by region

description: Run validation and verify accuracy thresholds
steps: Execute validation script against 200+ cities
Verify temperature MAE is under 3°F for 2-hour forecasts
Verify precipitation timing is within 10 minutes
Document any regions with lower accuracy
Generate final accuracy report

description: Add error handling and loading states
steps: Show loading skeleton while fetching weather data
Display user-friendly error messages on API failure
Implement retry mechanism for failed requests
Handle offline state gracefully

description: Add weather condition animations and visual polish
steps: Add subtle animations for weather icons
Implement precipitation intensity visualization on timeline
Add smooth transitions when scrubbing timeline
Ensure animations don't impact performance on mobile
